title: feat(spec,runtime): an AI route's req.user carries impersonatedBy and the admitting credential kind
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97ta8mBfzYTuf9TGyyF9wr9)_

Fixes #34184

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 路由交给处理函数的 `req.user` 多了两项：`impersonatedBy`（管理员模拟登录时是哪位管理员）和 `credential`（凭什么凭据进来：`session` / `api_key` / `oauth`）；spec 新增这个路由用户类型 `AIRouteUser` 和词表 `AIRouteCredentialKind`。
- 为什么改：cloud 的「待批动作只能本人决定」门需要分辨「是不是本人在操作、凭什么进来」，以前只能读请求头。按卡上裁决 6942875153 执行：Q1 A（用 Bearer 头携带的登录会话也算 `session`），Q2 A（`impersonatedBy` 原样交给门判断）。
- 风险与回滚：只新增字段，已有字段的值不变；`/actions` 和 MCP `run_action` 的 `ctx.user` 不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。另改了尚未发版的 33808 changeset 一句措辞（不再把 Bearer 令牌列为被拒凭据）。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/ai.ts`（组装 `req.user` 的一段）、`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`（`AIRouteUser` 的两项说明）、`.changeset/33808-ai-door-confirmation-in-app.md`（改的那一句）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/ai-request-user-credential.test.ts`，预期 9 个用例全过（cookie 会话、模拟会话、API Key、Bearer 会话各一例等）。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改 spec 契约（Tier H），待 L1 与契约复审通过后由席位请你批准。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec/contracts`** (`contracts/ai-service.ts`) declares the AI-route caller:
  - `AIRouteCredentialKind = 'session' | 'api_key' | 'oauth'`. `session` is a signed-in session whichever carrier brought its token (cookie or `Authorization: Bearer`), per ruling 6942875153 Q1 A.
  - `AIRouteUser extends EvalUser`: the actor envelope's keys (`id`, `userId`, `name`, `displayName`, `positions`, `permissions`, `systemPermissions`) plus two route facts, `impersonatedBy?` (carried as is, a fact the door judges and never the authorization subject, per Q2 A) and `credential?` (absent when the request recorded none; the contract tells a door to read anything but `'session'`, absence included, as not that session).
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**:
  - `domains/ai.ts` builds `req.user` as an `AIRouteUser`: the existing `actorUserFromExecutionContext` envelope, plus `impersonatedBy` from `ec.impersonatedBy` (trimmed; blank adds no key) and `credential` from `admittingCredentialKind(context)`, the one reading the environment-membership gate and the api-action forward already take. Both keys are absent, never `undefined`, when there is nothing to say.
  - `security/admitting-credential.ts`: `AdmittingCredentialKind` now names the spec's `AIRouteCredentialKind`, so the gate and the route spell the credential one way.
- **`.changeset/33808-ai-door-confirmation-in-app.md`** (pending, not yet released) — DELIBERATE CORRECTION of one FROM/TO line. Before: "with an API key or bearer token TO the person's signed-in session to the app." After: "with an API key, an OAuth token or another service credential TO the person's signed-in session to the app, whether its session token rides in the cookie or in an `Authorization: Bearer` header." The seat's execution note under ruling 6942875153 asked for this: under Q1 A a bearer-carried session is the person's session, so listing "bearer token" among refused credentials contradicted the ruling. `Check Changeset` may read the edit of another card's changeset; this paragraph is its declaration.
- New changeset `.changeset/34184-ai-route-user-credential.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/runtime` patch; `Metadata-protocol: none` takes patch).

No existing test was changed.

## Tests

New `packages/runtime/src/domains/ai-request-user-credential.test.ts`, 9 cases:

- Through `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()` (the real identity step, `resolveAuthzContext`): session cookie → `session`, no `impersonatedBy` key; impersonated session → `session` + `impersonatedBy` = the admin, `id` stays the user; API key (`x-api-key`) → `api_key`; API key beside an impersonated session cookie → `api_key`, no `impersonatedBy`; session token in `Authorization: Bearer` → `session`; impersonated session token in a bearer header → `session` + `impersonatedBy`. The fake auth service plays better-auth's bearer plugin (one session read per token, whichever carrier).
- At `handleAIRequest`: an agent principal carrying `oauthScopes` → `oauth`; an authenticated context with no admission → no `credential` key; a blank `impersonatedBy` → no key.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/runtime/src/domains/ai.ts --anchor ANCHOR (the two spread lines) --delete -- bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/ai-request-user-credential.test.ts"`

- mutation landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob d4c61d834758 → 9f870e2c9eaa
- `Tests  8 failed | 1 passed (9)`: every case pinning a key goes red; the one that stays green is the "no admission ⇒ no credential key" control, which an absent key satisfies by design.
- restored: blob == HEAD (d4c61d834758), `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `AIRouteUser` re-declares the actor envelope's key set that runtime's `ActorUser` (`security/actor-user.ts`) also declares; the runtime assignment `user: AIRouteUser = { ...actor, … }` makes the compiler refuse an `ActorUser` that loses a key the spec requires, but a key added to `ActorUser` alone would not be caught. Not filed: no reproducible defect today.
- The published texts that already say "token" without "bearer" (the semantic migration entry `in-app-pending-action-decided-by-person`, `.changeset/34189-pending-action-decide-session.md`, the `IAIService.rejectPendingAction` docblock) read as OAuth/service tokens under Q1 A and were left as is; the contract prose in `AI_ACTION_CONFIRMATION_CAPABILITY` already says "a delegated or OAuth token".
- Version Packages PR #33849 consumes `.changeset/*.md` when the maintainer releases: if it ships before this PR lands, the 33808 sentence goes out as it was and the correction becomes a docs-only amend of the released entry.

## Verification

Head `30f7347df0` (the second commit adds one module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` to the new test, which `check:test-source-alias` asked for; nothing else changed since `924dbf5b91`).

- Tests: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/ai-request-user-credential.test.ts src/domains/ai-request-user-capability-channel.test.ts src/domains/ai-anonymous-deny-ordering.test.ts src/action-ctx-user-shape.test.ts src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts` on `30f7347df0`: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 145 passed (145)`.
- Typecheck: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Spec artifacts: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date` (after `gen:api-surface` and `gen:export-origins`, the two it named stale).
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 92; all 92 ran with exit codes recorded; `dispatch-gates --ran` → `92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. 91 exit 0. The one red is `check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, by design: it refuses the edit of the pending `33808` note, which this PR declares above as a DELIBERATE CORRECTION. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered exit 3 (no dists) on the first pass and exit 0 after a full `pnpm build`; it and six test-family gates were re-run on `30f7347df0`.
- CI on `30f7347df0`: `Check Changeset` is red for the same reason (`Reject an empty-frontmatter changeset added by this PR`: `.changeset/33808-ai-door-confirmation-in-app.md exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR`), the confirming record being the seat's, per that gate's own text. Every other completed check is green or skipped by its filter; Test Core, Test UI and Type Check · workspace were still running when this was written.
- Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
